package.contributes.configuration.proper.text: Uhlu lwemafayela lwedatha yomsebenzisi we-Ukuphathwa Kwesitoreji Sami.

Izinga lokuningiliziwe lokuxazulula izingxenye zohlelo lwami. Ukuqopha amaphutha kudinga ukuthi isilungiselelo se-mydfrg.debugOn sinikwe amandla.
